steps.command:
set -e
mkdir -p /app/ssl
openssl genrsa -out /app/ssl/server.key 2048
chmod 600 /app/ssl/server.key
openssl req -new -x509 -key /app/ssl/server.key -out /app/ssl/server.crt -days 365 \
  -subj "/O=DevOps Team/CN=dev-internal.company.local"
chmod 644 /app/ssl/server.crt
cat /app/ssl/server.key /app/ssl/server.crt > /app/ssl/server.pem
chmod 600 /app/ssl/server.pem
{
  echo "Subject: $(openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -subject | sed 's/^subject=//')"
  echo "Not Before: $(openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -startdate | sed 's/^notBefore=//')"
  echo "Not After: $(openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -enddate | sed 's/^notAfter=//')"
  echo "SHA-256 Fingerprint: $(openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -fingerprint -sha256 | sed 's/^sha256 Fingerprint=//')"
} > /app/ssl/verification.txt
cat /app/ssl/verification.txt

sbx put check_cert.py <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import ssl
import sys
from datetime import datetime

CERT_PATH = "/app/ssl/server.crt"


def main():
    if not os.path.isfile(CERT_PATH):
        print(f"Error: certificate not found at {CERT_PATH}")
        return 1

    try:
        cert = ssl._ssl._test_decode_cert(CERT_PATH)
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"Error: failed to load certificate: {exc}")
        return 1

    common_name = None
    for rdn in cert.get("subject", ()):
        for key, value in rdn:
            if key == "commonName":
                common_name = value

    not_after = cert.get("notAfter")
    if not not_after:
        print("Error: certificate has no expiration date")
        return 1

    expiration = datetime.strptime(not_after, "%b %d %H:%M:%S %Y %Z")
    expiration_date = expiration.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

    print(f"Common Name: {common_name}")
    print(f"Expiration Date: {expiration_date}")
    print("Certificate verification successful")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
EOF
sbx run <<'EOF'
chmod 755 /app/check_cert.py
python3 /app/check_cert.py
echo "---"
ls -la /app/ssl /app/check_cert.py
openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -subject -dates -fingerprint -sha256
EOF
